svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Half section and half elevation of a slender fluted column with a tall bell capital wrapped in two rows of acanthus leaves, carrying an entablature with dentils and modillions. Source: Proportions after Giacomo Barozzi da Vignola, Regola delli cinque ordini d’architettura (Rome, 1562). Simplified; drawn by Project Exodus.
